ui_idle_hint: Chofoza ku-ayikhoni yesengeto kute ufinyete leli khasi.
ui_truncated: Leli khasi belilidze; kufinyetwe incenye yekucala kuphela.
error_page_unreadable: Leli khasi alifundzeki. Emakhasi esiphequluli kanye ne-Chrome Web Store akasekelwa.
error_no_content: Akukho umbhalo we-athikili lotfoliwe kuleli khasi.
error_needs_click: Chofoza ku-ayikhoni yesengeto kute ufinyete leli khasi. Ngemuva kwekutsi ithebhu iye kulelinye likhasi, lesengeto sidzinga kuchofoza lokusha kute silifundze.
error_host_missing: Incenye yasekhaya ayifakiwe noma ayiphenduli. Kufolda yesengeto, sebentisa: ./native-host/install.sh
error_claude_missing: I-Claude Code ayitfolakalanga. Yifake, bese usebentisa futsi ./native-host/install.sh
error_claude_auth: Awungenanga ku-Claude Code. Sebentisa claude ku-thheminali bese uyangena.
error_codex_signed_out: Awungenanga ku-Codex. Sebentisa codex login ku-thheminali.
error_codex_not_eligible: Luhlelo lwakho lwe-ChatGPT alukwati kusetjentiselwa loku. Khetsa lomunye umhlinzeki.
error_usage_limit: Ufike emkhawulweni wekusebentisa weluhlelo lwakho. Zama futsi ngemuva noma ukhetse lomunye umhlinzeki.
error_provider_failed: Umhlinzeki uhlulekile ngesikhatsi abhala sifinyeto. Zama futsi.
error_codex_missing: I-Codex ayitfolakalanga. Yifake, bese usebentisa futsi ./native-host/install.sh
options_help: Tifinyeto tendlula encenyeni yasekhaya kulekhompyutha: isebentisa i-Claude Code noma i-Codex ngekubhalisa kwakho, noma imodeli ku-Ollama. Umbhalo welikhasi utfunyelwa kuphela kumhlinzeki lomkhetsako.
error_ollama_missing: I-Ollama ayisebenti kulekhompyutha. Yifake usuka ku-ollama.com uyivule, bese uyetama futsi.
error_ollama_model_missing: Lemodeli ayikadawunilodwa ku-Ollama. Sebentisa ollama pull nelibito lemodeli (sibonelo, ollama pull llama3.2), bese uyetama futsi.
options_models_auto: Luchamuka ku-Claude Code, Codex na-Ollama, futsi lufundvwa futsi kanye ngelilanga, nangabe i-Claude Code noma i-Codex ibuyeketiwe, nangabe sengeto sibuyeketiwe.
error_file_access: Kute ufinyete emafayela lakulelikhompyutha, vula Imininingwane yesengeto ku-chrome://extensions bese uvula Vumela kufinyelela kuma-URL emafayela.
error_pdf_unreadable: Le-PDF ayivuleki. Kungenteka ivikelwe ngephasiwedi noma yonakele.
error_pdf_no_text: Le-PDF ayinawo umbhalo longawufinyeta. Kungenteka yentiwe ngetitfombe letiskeniwe.
history_empty: Kute tifinyeto okwanyalo. Titawuvela lapha njengoba utenta.
error_no_transcript: Le-vidiyo ayinawo umbhalo wekukhulumako longawufinyeta. YouTube inawo kuphela nangabe i-vidiyo inemibhalo ngaphansi nobe imibhalo ngaphansi letentekelako.
options_styles_help: Sitayela sengeta umyalo esifinyetweni, sibonelo: Kufinyete njengelucatsaniso lwetintfo letitfunyelwe letimfisha letintsatfu.
